# JLL retained observations experiment

Part of [AGENTIC-2902](https://linear.app/agenticassets/issue/AGENTIC-2902). This is an offline private-file experiment, disconnected from collection, ingestion, database, scheduler and lifecycle. It neither verifies source rights nor claims completeness or currency. Inputs and outputs can contain sensitive listings, contacts, credentials and other private data. Do not commit, upload or share them.

`python3 jll_retained_observations.py --input /private/retained.json --out /private/new-observations.json` reads a bounded regular file without following its final symlink and creates an exclusive mode-0600 output. Preserve the input unchanged; its SHA-256 is a consistency pointer, not authentication. Parent directories are caller controlled. Native Windows fails closed; use WSL. Per-file metadata checks cannot authenticate source or defeat all hostile filesystem races.

Every listing remains a separate unresolved observation. If every row has validated visible pricing, its complete listing object is retained as private data. Parent broker and source metadata are not copied. If any row is withheld, unknown or malformed, the whole artifact is conservatively guarded because cross-row identity is unresolved: only numeric physical fields allowed by the existing JLL safe projection are retained as unvalidated source values, including out-of-range coordinates, and omissions are recorded. Nested merged passes or hidden, malformed, or unknown controls also trigger the guard. The input remains the recovery source for omitted facts. This conservative mode is not proof that output is safe to disclose; it avoids depending on heuristic free-text price redaction. Conflicting controls and cross-pass matches are never resolved by guessing.

The recursive guard checks `hidePrice`, `priceWithholdingControl`, `jllPriceWithheld`, `searchWithholdingControl`, `detailWithholdingControl` and `visibility` case-insensitively throughout each row. It permits only visible or absent search/detail controls, and visible visibility; other values trigger the guard. Separator variants of these names trigger the guard regardless of value. These conservative checks do not assert JLL emits every shape. Other provider-specific controls may be unrecognized. Preserve the original private input for exact recovery and review.
